empty_state_dashboard.description: Subtle abstract background for empty states or dashboard headers.

success_state.description: Use for success messages or completion milestones.

accessibility.contrast: Text colors must maintain 4.5:1 ratio against background. Use slate-400 for secondary text, never darker.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus rings (blue-500) for keyboard navigation.
accessibility.aria_labels: All icon-only buttons must have aria-label.

general: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for overlays.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖, 🧠, etc.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Update /app/frontend/src/index.css with the HSL values provided in 'colors.palette'. This is CRITICAL for the dark theme.
2. Ensure 'tailwind.config.js' extends the theme to include these CSS variables if not already present.
3. Implement the Dashboard using the Bento Grid strategy defined in 'layout.grid_strategy'.
5. Use 'recharts' for the Completion Ring Chart.
6. Build the 'Sidebar' for desktop and 'BottomNav' for mobile as separate components.
7. For the 'TasksPage', implement a filterable list with 'AnimatePresence' for smooth entry/exit.
8. Use the provided image URLs for empty states (e.g., when no tasks are present).
